headline: Fortis Global Insurance Narrows Quarterly Loss on Recapitalisation
summary: Fortis Global Insurance Plc posted a pre-tax loss of N1.38 billion for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, narrowing from a loss of N2.17 billion a year earlier as recapitalisation efforts lifted cash reserves to N27.45 billion.
why: Fortis Global Insurance operates in Nigeria's financial sector, where regulatory recapitalisation mandates drive balance sheet restructuring and insurer solvency.

impacts.name: Fortis Global Insurance Plc
impacts.why: Recapitalisation boosted cash reserves while operational losses decreased.
